newsitem.title: USA: FED SEEN ADDING RESERVES VIA OVERNIGHT SYSTEM RPS.
newsitem.headline: FED SEEN ADDING RESERVES VIA OVERNIGHT SYSTEM RPS.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was forecast to add reserves into the banking system on Tuesday through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements.
But analysts added that there was a chance they won't act, because the Fed added reserves on Monday via $4.83 billion in three-day fixed system RPs.

"However, with the maintenance system ending (Wednesday), the Fed did not try to finish its add job with (Monday's) system RPs," said analysts at MCM MoneyWatch. "Rather, it left room to return with overnight system RPs today and tomorrow to make fine-tuning adjustments."
Federal funds were trading at 5-9/16 percent, above the 5-1/2 percent target rate in morning trading.
